subject.title: feat(gateway): thread authenticated user identity into presence

question: Should a shared gateway expose the raw trusted-proxy/Tailscale identity string as `presence[].user.id` to every client receiving presence before durable user profiles exist?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically additive, but the answer determines the privacy and long-term protocol contract; code review cannot safely choose between a temporary email key and deferring visibility until a durable profile identifier exists.

options.title: Approve shared-gateway identity visibility
options.body: Accept the raw authenticated identity as the temporary presence key within the documented trusted shared-gateway boundary, with redacted live proof before merge.

options.title: Defer visible identity until profiles
options.body: Keep connection-local audit attribution but postpone presence identity publication until the related durable-profile work supplies a stable non-email identifier.

recommendation.title: Approve shared-gateway identity visibility
recommendation.body: Accept the raw authenticated identity as the temporary presence key within the documented trusted shared-gateway boundary, with redacted live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The related identity-program issue and recent merged gateway protocol work place this product and compatibility decision closest to steipete.
